properties.displayName: UAV S40 - Anti-Forensics (Log Deletion / Black Box Tamper)
properties.description: 드론 anti-forensics 탐지 — UAVFileAudit_CL(컨테이너 파일시스템 감사)에서 LogBearingTargetSuspected=true(로그/블랙박스/감사기록을 대상으로 하는 것으로 의심되는 파일 작업)로 플래그된 이벤트를 탐지. Operation이 삭제/절단류(delete/truncate/unlink)인 경우와 PersistenceTargetSuspected가 동시에 참인 경우를 구분해 사유를 산출. 실제 컬럼: ContainerName, Pid, ProcessName, Operation, FilePath, BytesAccessed, User, Syscall, LogBearingTargetSuspected, PersistenceTargetSuspected(UAVAuditLog_CL/RecordCountBefore/RecordCountAfter/TimestampDeltaSec 컬럼은 존재하지 않아 제거함). MITRE: T1070
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVFileAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where LogBearingTargetSuspected == true
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    Operation in ("delete", "truncate", "unlink") and PersistenceTargetSuspected == true, "안티포렌식_로그삭제절단_퍼시스턴스_동시",
    Operation in ("delete", "truncate", "unlink"), "안티포렌식_로그파일_삭제절단",
    PersistenceTargetSuspected == true, "안티포렌식_로그변조_퍼시스턴스_의심",
    "안티포렌식_로그베어링_타겟_접근")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, Pid, ProcessName, Operation, FilePath, BytesAccessed, User, Syscall, LogBearingTargetSuspected, PersistenceTargetSuspected, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S40 - Anti-Forensics (Log Deletion / Black Box Tamper) - {{ContainerName}}
